remarks: Discover this beautifully renovated multi-family home, updated in/out in the last 10 years, offering modern living in a desirable neighborhood. This property is perfect for investors, first-time homebuyers, or families seeking extra space. *Key Features: - *Spacious Layout: The home features two main floors, each with a nice mixture of tile and HW, three comfortable bedrooms, ideal for families or rental opportunities. -*Bathrooms: The first floor includes two full baths-one attached to the primary bedroom-and the second floor has an additional full bath. -*Finished Basement: Enjoy a finished basement with two additional bedrooms, living room, kitchen and a full bath, providing versatile living space that won't count towards square footage, making it perfect for guests or a relative. -*Versatile Attic Space: A walk-up finished attic with private entry offers even more possibilities, ideal for an office, guest room, play area or whatever suits. - *Recent Renovations: Modern finishes and fixtures throughout make this home move-in ready. *Ideal for Various Buyers:* Real Estate Investors: A great opportunity for generating rental income. - *First-Time Homebuyers: Live in one unit and rent out the other to help cover mortgage costs. - **Growing Families: Plenty of room for families looking for more space. - **Multi-Generational Living: Accommodate multiple generations under one roof. - *Young Professionals: Share living expenses in a great environment.
